evaluators.purpose: Offline replay: schema, exact citation identity, context references and missing evidence.
limitations: One open synthetic replay family; no acceptance dataset or independent human labels.
Typed references do not prove free-text grounding or AML meaning.
Expected synthetic INCOMPLETE is a correct evaluator response, not a failed qualification.

evaluators.purpose: Scenario oracle: hand-calculated facts and exact rule versions; harmless fact-order invariance.
limitations: Exact current wording and one synthetic transaction; not a free-text semantic judge.
Reordering the same facts creates no independent scenario.

evaluators.purpose: Repeat evaluator: factual violations, metadata invariance and full planned denominators.
limitations: Reports are synthetic; no LLM, transport or model identity is measured.
Two repetitions of one family do not prove statistical stability or ordering usefulness.

evaluators.purpose: Exact citation ranking metrics with fixed k, missing retrieval and zero-label scope.
limitations: No embedding or vector database is called.
Synthetic labels do not establish relevance, applicable legislation or real search quality.

evaluators.purpose: Judge response protocol and advisory aggregation: quotations, false approvals, missing observations and human boundaries.
limitations: Hand-written responses exercise software contracts, not a real Judge model.
Known engineering labels are not human calibration; historical Judge FAIL is not reassessed.

evaluators.purpose: Result aggregation: zero tests, skips, known failures and absent JUnit cannot support a claimed PASS.
limitations: Small synthetic JSON and JUnit exercise report interpretation only.
This control does not prove that the reported tests actually ran or qualify an external CI service.

controls.description: One valid replay and one valid citation give 1/1 schema and traceability; synthetic product acceptance remains incomplete.
Change only the outcome citation version to v2 while the catalog remains v1; schema stays valid but traceability becomes 0/1.
Remove the only observed outcome; one missing outcome remains and both zero-denominator metrics are undefined.
Reference ABSENT-TX in a typed fact: valid JSON and citation cannot hide invalid context evidence.
An unknown replay envelope field is rejected with the documented exact BundleInputError code.
Six hand-written facts match one 10.00 RUB transaction, profile and v1 rule.
Change the total's wording from 10.00 to 99.00 while typed evidence remains 10.00; exact fact oracle must detect it.
Substitute v2 only in the selected report rule; the v1 golden rule remains unchanged.
Reverse the six facts without changing their content or evidence; the scenario oracle is order-insensitive.
Change only generated report_id and generated_at between two valid reports; ordered and semantic fingerprints stay equal.
Replace a profile fact with an unsupported approval sentence; repetition checks must preserve the factual error.
Supply one successful repeat for two planned slots; pass rate stays 1/2 and independence count stays one.
One valid and one factually wrong report fill two slots; failure remains visible and the failed slot stays in the denominator.
At k=2, one relevant v1 citation is first and one irrelevant v2 citation is second: precision 1/2, recall 1, reciprocal rank 1.
A sole v2 citation is not the expected v1 identity even though rule_id is the same.
Observed empty retrieval with one expected citation is a measured miss; k remains two rather than shrinking to zero.
No relevant labels means no ranking denominator; returned candidates cannot manufacture a measured success.
Duplicate the first identity after k=2; truncation must not hide invalid observations beyond the cutoff.
A hand-written protocol-valid response quotes an exact supplied source fragment; this validates format, not judgement accuracy.
An invented quotation must be rejected with the exact contextual reference error.
Remove required rationale from otherwise valid JSON; require the response-fields rejection.
Three planned controls contain one correct pass, one false approval and one timeout: accuracy 1/3 and false approval 1/2; no human calibration or gate override.
Only one correct response arrives for two planned controls; missing remains one and all-planned accuracy 1/2 without implying human agreement.
One passing test with consistent JSON, JUnit and contract checks supports PASS within report interpretation scope.
A claimed PASS with zero tests and empty JUnit remains incomplete.
One skipped test invalidates a claimed successful run.
JSON claims PASS but both counts and JUnit contain a failure; retain FAIL.
A passing JSON without its JUnit companion cannot establish complete evidence.
An observed failure remains FAIL even when the companion JUnit is absent; incompleteness must not erase failure.
